name: justify-hyphen-proof
title: Justify Hyphen Proof
description: A justified paragraph with manual soft-hyphen control and rivers visualisation: toggle justification, hyphenation and a river-detector overlay that highlights the vertical gaps justified text leaves behind.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Toggle Proof: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
